data.one_liner: A Dart package to communicate with Microsoft Azure App Configuration.
data.what_it_does: It allows developers to communicate with Microsoft Azure App Configuration KeyValue and FeatureFlag resources. It supports retrieving key values, feature flags, handling feature filters, and custom type serialization.
use_when: You need to fetch configuration key-values from Azure App Configuration in a Flutter or Dart app.
You are using feature flags and feature filters like Microsoft.Targeting or Microsoft.TimeWindow in Azure.
avoid_when: You are using a backend configuration service other than Microsoft Azure.
You require complex state management solutions built specifically for your UI.
strengths: Supports built-in Azure feature filters like targeting and time windows.
Allows custom type registration for automatic encode and decode.
Cross-platform support including web, mobile, and desktop.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on some advanced configuration scenarios outside the README examples.
data.setup_notes: Requires an Azure App Configuration connection string from the Azure Portal.
